content.title: Ralston House
content.summary: Ralston House Child Advocacy Center collaborates with law enforcement and community services in the 1st and 17th Judicial Districts to provide a safe environment for investigating child abuse and offering victim services to affected children. It serves multiple cities, including Arvada, and works closely with the Arvada Police Department.
content.body:
Ralston House Child Advocacy Center works with law enforcement, human services, district attorney’s offices in the 1st and 17th Judicial Districts (Jefferson, Adams, Gilpin and Broomfield counties), and the community to provide a safe place to investigate child abuse and ensure victim services for children who have been physically or sexually abused or witnessed violence.

Ralston House serves several cities and police agencies including the City of Arvada and the Arvada Police Department. For more information, visit the [Ralston House website](https://www.ralstonhouse.org/).
